name: Sant'Angelo Muxaro (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sant'Angelo Muxaro (a saint, a heron and other charges) within branches, with a motto scroll beneath.
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 12 January 2021.

features.role: Sant'Angelo Muxaro arms — saint, heron and other charges, crowned, within branches, with motto scroll
